lokele: Paulo la Silwano la Timoteo, iso tosotoma lokasa-lo ende eb’Etanda ya Tesalonika eyomani la Mungu Sango la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya. Booto la lilatemi biyaleke lanu!
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: 1:1 Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Totofaekefa Mungu kelekele eoka yanu mbile la mbile ani totosingwaka baina banu nda basomboli basu;
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

lokele: toitomacha ndoenyakela likuwa lia liimeli lianu la bonui wa losamɔ loanu la bokokomu wa iɛli shanu loasɔ loa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, nda baiso ba Mungu Sango wasu.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

lokele: Eoka, Bitungani ebasamomu ba Mungu, tosoluwa mbo bosoaomo lande;
english: We know, brothers 1:4 loved by God, that you are chosen,

lokele: eoka Mboli Ilau ebitonangol’iso, bitiayak’end’ino ko la lioi lia bɔnɔkɔ kongo, kangä imɔ la bofoka la isosha sha Bolimo Botanu la yao lokuliomo lanu finɛ, ongoma to oluwi nde bɔfɔnɔ wa bato ewayalak’iso sisi yanu ko l’eoka yanu;
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

lokele: la ino lokweekel’iso la Ngɛnɛ wasu ani aimelak’ino wɛndi ko la bifembi wike, amamwito La bootaota wa Bolimo Botanu;
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

lokele: ko ongoma ino bosoɛnɛlɛ kwa etichelo ende ebimeli batotina nda yese ya Makedonia l’eya Akaiya lisanga.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

lokele: Eoka wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ bosokuswa end’ino okokana kwa ifonge, inga to nda Makedonia la Akaiya kongo, kangä imɔ nda biese bitotina, lilendelu lianu liolendelo Mungu lisomelana, la ongoma iso totieno imɔ ndoonga lioi ango limɔi.
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

lokele: Eoka bato ana angɛnɛ batomelekesa mboli ya fɛtɛti yasu olo eyanu la mbo wamachaka bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu ndokikwa ende Mungu wa wewe oyale la liwawi, ndoyala bɛkɔwa ya Mungu angɛnɛ,
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

lokele: la ndoumbakela Wana wande ani akasulweke Inde se nda Use, Mungu atɛmolɔk’ïnde nda liwa, ako Yesu oyasɔɔnɔkɔlɔk’iso nda efango eyekayeke.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

lokele: Bitungani yami, ino angɛnɛ to nd’aluwi mbo fɛtɛti eyayak’iso omolo end’ino etiayaka liyëlä,
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

lokele: kongo ko okak’iso biale finɛ la akelomoko iso sɔni nda Filipoi, kwa aluw’ino, twatendelaka ko la lisungi lia Mungu ndonangoel’ino Mboli Ilau ya Mungu atiteni ya bifembi wike.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

lokele: Eoka lifumbesi lia inango shasu liti lia batwanelo, liti lia bɔlɛlɔ, liti ango la bolimbakeli;
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

lokele: kongo ko kwa asokuliomo iso ko la Mungu angɛnɛ ndolendelomo nda linangoli lia Mboli Ilau, ko ani to tosoonga, inga ndoomalesa bato angɛnɛ, kangä Mungu oyatokotakela betema yasu.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

lokele: Eoka ino nd’aluwi mbo tociaɔngɔlɔk’ino la baoi basu ango ko la litina liololaka yeka yanu, kwa aluwi nde Mungu;
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

lokele: totialukaka lokuku loa bato, angoko end’ino, angoko ende bato basi imɔ, ani twakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndokomya ino la isosha kwa esha Batomomu ba Masiya.
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

lokele: Kongo ko twayalanaka lanu la bɔfɔu kwa bana’oli la kwa nyango oyatokukia bana bande angɛnɛ.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

lokele: Aniyak’iso oniy’ino ongoma twayalaka la limɛngɔ ndokael’ino, inga ko Mboli Ilau ya Mungu kongo, kangä imɔ ko bawawi basu lisanga, eoka bosoyala ebasamomu lasu.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

lokele: Bitungani yami, osoenyakela to likuwa lia bonui la likati eliakelakak’iso la ocho la löwa, litina mbo totayala la bolito end’ino ango ɔmɔi, eyanangoelak’iso enangoel’ino Mboli Ilau ya Mungu.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

lokele: Ino nd’aluwi la Mungu imɔ aluwi eoka osɔɛnɛ mbo boyaeli wasu sisi yanu ebimeli wende la botanu la liengani la boti la litwanelo ango limɔi;
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

lokele: ino nd’aluwi imɔ ko mbo, twafumbesak’ino, boto la boto, kwa atokelaka sango ende bana bande,
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

lokele: twaɔnjɔnjak’ino, twaimak’ino mbo oyalakeke la boyaeli woengana bato ba Mungu oyasot’ino lioi mbo ɔɔtɛkɛ nda Bɔkɔta la nda tala yande angɛnɛ.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

lokele: Ko l’eoka ya litina-li, iso imɔ totimache ndofaefa Mungu kelekele eoka mbo imelak’ino wɛndi wa Mungu ewokak’ino end’iso, otiaaelaka wao kwa mbo wɛndi wa bato kongo, kangä mbo wende wɛndi wa Mungu wewe la mbo wao bokokelaka likuwa nda betema yanu ebasoimela.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

lokele: Bitungani, ino nd’asokweekela to bitanda ya Mungu ya bato ebasoomana la Yesu Masiya, ebile nda Yudea; mbo ino nd’asookesomo bifembi-ao ko la besamba ya bato ba tukela yanu, kwa aokesomoko iyo ko la besamba ya BaYuda,
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

lokele: ebaolaka la Ngɛnɛ Yesu la Batɔndɔli imɔ l’ebasokongoï’iso, ongoma batiomalese Mungu nde bende biyani la bato batotina,
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

lokele: ani asokufes’iyo okufes’iso ndoongana la ebati ba tukela yasi mbo buwesomoko, litina mbo ko mbile bitotina baɔlɔɛkɛ ikweelo sha batwanelo bau; kongo ko efango esoosh’iyo nda tuu.
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

lokele: Bitungani, eoka mbo tososɛnyana lanu ko mbile sinyo kongo, ko lɔsɛnyano loa bindo ebisoɛnɛlɛ, inga eloa betema yasu, ongoma twalɛmbɛkɛ la yɛmɛ finɛ ndɔɛnɛ biɔmbɔ yanu liasi,
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

lokele: eingo, twalɛmbɛkɛ ndoyɛn’ino, ko imi Paulo liasi la liasi, nde Satana akufesaka nd’iso.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

lokele: ¿Ndai to koyala iɛli shasu, kwa linɛngina liasu, kwa iyoyo sha iomala shasu, oso wa bɔmbɔ wa Ngɛnɛ Yesu nda bayelo bande, mbo bati imɔ ko ino?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus 2:19 at his coming?

lokele: Eingo, ino wende tala la linɛngina liasu.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

lokele: Eokao, ani atiakɔkɔlɔkɔ iso ndoumwak’imɔ, twasangaka ndomachana nda Atenai ko iso angɛnɛ,
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

lokele: la iso lotoma Timoteo, etungani yasu la bokuwi wa Mungu nda Mboli Ilau ya Masiya, litina mbo akɔkɔmɛsɛk’ino la mbo afumbesek’ino nda lilendelu lianu,
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

lokele: litina mbo boto angɔmɔi wanu ataeyaeya eoka ya bifembi-bi, eoka ino angɛnɛ nd’aluwi mbo lole loasɔ loasu ngo ko ongoma.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

lokele: La ayalak’iso amamwito lanu, iso lokambes’ino oso mbo totokesomoko bifembi ongoma la kwani bisokweel’ino, kwa aluwi nd’ino.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

lokele: Eoka ya litina-li, ani itikɔkɔlɛ ndoumwak’imɔ, yatomaka wɛndi ndoluwa ani ayali lilendelu lianu, eoka mbo Bokotakeli atakotel’ino la mbo bonui wa likuwa liasu litayala ko wawa.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

lokele: Kongo ko kwani asoinwa Timoteo end’iso la asoyaeshel’iso mboli ilau ya lilendelu lianu la losamɔ loanu la asokambes’inde okambes’iso mbo otoenyakel’iso la olau, mbile bitotina, la mbo otoyalaka la yɛmɛ yɔɛn’iso, kwa iso imɔ ko ndɔɛn’ino,
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

lokele: ko la litina-li, Bitungani, betema yasu bisoaesomo se loasɔ loanu la bifembi la tale yanu, ko ol lilendelu lianu,
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

lokele: eoka kwani asok’iso ongoma mba osokɔkɔmɔ fii ende Ngɛnɛ, tokoyali nde la liwawi liyai.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

lokele: ¿Boni to bɔfɔnɔ wa kelekele ebisokɔkɔl’iso ndoinoela Mungu eoka yanu, loasɔ loa limɛngɔ litotina elitoyaimwa lasu eoka yanu nda baiso ba Mungu?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

lokele: La ocho la löwa, totosombokola la sheteseli mbo twɛnɛnɛkɛ lanu l’ɔmbɔ l’ɔmbɔ la mbo tokɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ bina ebisoomelo nda lilendelu lianu.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

lokele: Nde Mungu angɛnɛ la Sango wasu, la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu alongameseke mboka yasu fii ko end’ino;
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

lokele: la Ngɛnɛ aulweseke la atumeseke losamɔ loanu losamakana la elosama batotina imɔ kwa ayali imɔ eloasu end’ino,
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

lokele: litina mbo Inde akɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ betema yanu mbo biyaleke bitanu l’angwɛnɛ ango litwanelo, kangä liengani nda baiso ba Mungu Sango wasu nda bayelo ba Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu, amamwito la ebüchomu bande batotina!
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

lokele: TUU ya loasɔ, Bitungani, tosoomba la tosolɔmbɔkɔl’ino nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu, mbo kwa okak’ino end’iso loasɔ loa boyaeli wanu wa bɔkɛndɛli wanu, la boomaleseli woomalesa Mungu, la kwa atokelaka ino ko kwani, mbo takɛndɛlɛkɛ to oso nda wao.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

lokele: Eoka oluwi nde bakakanelo ebatelak’iso etel’ino la isosha sha Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

lokele: Eoka eli liende lisangi lia Mungu, liko liüchomu litanu lianu, mbo bokileke ndotwa nyongo;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

lokele: la mbo boto la boto wanu aluweke ndɔɔlɔ wali wande angɛnɛ ewüchomu la lolitesomo,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body 4:4 in sanctification and honor,

lokele: inga to la ifoifoi sha yɛmɛ ya bolëfë kwa esha tukela yasi ya wenda ebatiluwe Mungu,
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

lokele: mbo boto atalimba etungani yande ndokeel’inde litwanelo nda loasɔ-lo. Eoka Ngɛnɛ wasu nd’ayali Bosakanesi wa njasɔ bitotina-bi, kwa asotaonga’mi lanu oso ndoaesel’ino litina se la wɛlï.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

lokele: Eoka Mungu atit’iso lioi mbo toyaleke la bɔlɛlɔ kangä mbo tüchomoko la botanu.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

lokele: Eokao, oyatotefola ekela-ye, atitefole bolomboki, kangä to Mungu oyasofaekef’ino Bolimo Botanu.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

lokele: Nde nda loasɔ loa lisamani lia bitungani, oti ango la boeno wɔsɔnɛlɔmɔ lokasa, eoka ino angɛnɛ osoekesomo la Mungu ndosamakana;
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

lokele: eingo ino nd’asami bitungani bitotina nda yese etotina ya Makedonia. Kongo ko tosolɔmbɔkɔl’ino Bitungani ndokelak’imɔ ongoma la ndoetela eloa oso,
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

lokele: la fɔɔlɔkɔ ko ndɔɔngɛsɛ njasɔ la lilatemi la ndotimbakana, boto la boto ko loasɔ loande angɛnɛ la ndokelaka likuwa la besamba yanu angɛnɛ, kwa asokambes’iso ekambes’ino oso,
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

lokele: litina mbo boyaeli wanu boenganeke nda baiso ba bato ebati b’Etanda la mbo botaeno boto angɔmɔi wosung’ino. Loasɔ loa eb’Etanda ebasoingala tɔlɔ twa liwa
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

lokele: Bitungani, totilɛmbɛ mbo oyaleke la botutuku nda loasɔ loa ebasoingala tɔlɔ twa liwa, mbo ino otawa ikɛnɛnɛ imɔ kwa bato basi ebati l’iɛli.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

lokele: Eoka ango toimela mbo Yesu awaka la atɛmwaka liasi, ko ongoma ko la Yesu, Mungu atotolanesa ebasoingala tɔlɔ amamwito lande.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

lokele: Eoka tosokambes’ino e-loasɔ-lo ko la lioi lia Ngɛnɛ, liko mbo iso ebakayaleke la liwawi la ebakatikaleke ko nda bayelo ba Ngɛnɛ, totiaetelek’iyo oso ebaingalaka tɔlɔ;
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

lokele: eoka Ngɛnɛ ko Inde angɛnɛ nd’atoya se la liamami lia isosha, la limiki lia bokitomo wa taïa, la ifonge sha Mungu oyatosokwa nda Use, limɔ ebawaka ko ende Yesu, belatɛmwaka oso;
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

lokele: lamao iso ebakatikaleke la liwawi, tolailakomoko amamwito lau ko nda bafita ndokatowana la Ngɛnɛ k’olo likolo, ko ongoma tolayalaka nde layalaya amamwito la Ngɛnɛ.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

lokele: Eokao latemesaka betema ko la e baoi-ba.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

lokele: Nde nda loasɔ loa mbile la basho, Bitungani yami, oti la boeno wosɔnɛlɔmɔkɔ lokasa,
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

lokele: eoka ino nd’aluwi la wɛlï mbo Lise lia Ngɛnɛ liyaka nde kwa atoya wiya la ocho.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

lokele: Akaongek’iyo mbo— Lilatemi kwani, tosotekama! kwaamao lisɛɛsɛli litoomanel’iyo futuku kwa atoyaka toelo ende botomali oyatoli lieme, angokwel’imɔ botili.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

lokele: Kongo ko, Bitungani, ino otiyale nda lilima, mbo lise lina koomanel’ino futuku kwa wiya,
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

lokele: eoka ino yaatotina wende bana ba liangangi la bana ba löwa; toti bato ba ocho angoko eba lilima,
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

lokele: Eokao to toingalëke tɔlɔ kwa atoingala bato basi, nde toyaleke la botengu, angomwa bänä;
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

lokele: eoka ebatoingala tɔlɔ batoingakala tɔlɔ ko la ocho, la ebatowa bänä, batowa bao imɔ ko la ocho.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

lokele: Kongo ko asoyalak’iso bana ba löwa, totinganeke la boyaeli wasu la wɛlï, towateke botaka wa lilendelu la losamɔ la kɔmɔ ya yeto eko iɛli sha liuwesi.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

lokele: Eoka Mungu atiukames’iso ndowa efango, kangä ndɔɔlɔ liuwesi ko la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya,
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

lokele: oyawelak’iso, litina mbo, ango toyala la botengu, ango toingala tɔlɔ, ani toyaleke ngo ko la liwawi amamwito lande.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

lokele: Eokao latemesaka betema, la kɔkɔmɛlɛkɛ boto la boto, kwa atokelaka nd’ino kwani. Beimo la bakakanelo basi
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

lokele: Tosoomb’ino liasi, Bitungani, mbo oluwaneke lau ebatokuwel’ino la bonui l’ebale Betoli oso wanu nda njasɔ ya Ngɛnɛ, ebatoimak’ino.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

lokele: Tɛmiak’iyo la losamɔ finɛ eoka ya likuwa liau. Yalakanaka la lilatemi.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

lokele: Tosolɔmbɔkɔl’ino, Bitungani, mbo— Imaka eba booshaosha, fumbesaka bilɛɛlɛ ya bato, tinganaka l’eba bɔlɛmbu, owëke esole loasɔ loa boto angɔmɔi.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

lokele: Lambaka mbo otakundanëke bobe ko la bosakane ende boto angɔmɔi; nde lise la lise engaka fofe yokelakane bolau la ende bato batotina lisanga.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

lokele: Okaka limɛngɔ lise la lise;
english: Always rejoice.

lokele: omachëke ndosombokola,
english: Pray without ceasing.

lokele: faekefaka Mungu kelekele nda beyaeli bitotina, eoka lisangi lia Mungu elisoyel’iso ko la Yesu Masiya lile ngo ko ongoma.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

lokele: Otungesëke Bolimo;
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

lokele: osɛɔlɛ̈kɛ litɔndɔli.
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

lokele: Kongo ko kɔtɔlɔkɔ bitotina mbo olembeeleke la oundeke ko yao ebile bilau,
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

lokele: la kilaka bobe wa kanda bitotina. Lisomboli lia losilo loa lokasa
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

lokele: Mungu wa lilatemi, Inde angɛnɛ aukamesek’ino hukaa, la belimo la betema la bindo yanu bitekakemeke teka, angwɛnɛ ango litwanelo, nda bayelo ba Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya!
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Inde oyasot’ino lioi ende wolendelomu, la Inde nd’atokɔcha liao.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

lokele: Bitungani, sombokoelak’iso;
english: Brothers, pray for us.

lokele: lamokolaka bitungani bitotina y’Etanda la tɔchou etüchomu.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

lokele: Isotel’ino ekano ko la lina lia Ngɛnɛ mbo e-lokasa-lo lotangomoko ende bitungani bitotina y’Etanda.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

lokele: Booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya boyalakeke lanu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
